The existing 2020 Fiji_v2.6 precipitation coefficient is retained as the model baseline rather than replacing it with the CCKP historical climatology.
rationale: Preserves the calibrated model starting point while applying only the sourced relative climate signal.

statement: SC_0 uses the CCKP CMIP6 SSP2-4.5 ensemble-median annual precipitation anomaly; p10 and p90 are retained as uncertainty evidence but are not forced into the central run.
rationale: Central scenario requested by the user; sensitivity cases remain a disclosed extension.

statement: The 2020-2039 climatology is anchored at model year 2030 and the 2040-2059 climatology at model year 2050; annual multipliers are linearly interpolated from 2020.
rationale: CCKP publishes period climatologies rather than deterministic annual forecasts.

statement: Each annual precipitation multiplier is also applied to inherited evapotranspiration, groundwater-recharge and surface-runoff OARs for every national land technology.
rationale: Preserves the inherited hydrological partition and keeps precipitation physically linked to ENV_WATER.
notes: This is a transparent response assumption rather than a calibrated rainfall-runoff model.

statement: 2020 capture service is carried flat through 2050
rationale: Avoids an unsupported fishing expansion target.

statement: Diesel/electric capture efficiencies are 0.30/0.75
rationale: Diesel matches existing navigation convention; electric is an engineering prior.

statement: Capture residual stock uses 70% historical utilization
rationale: Separates stock sizing from technical availability.

statement: Aquaculture operations use 0.5 kWh/kg harvest
rationale: No Fiji facility energy series is published.

statement: Aquaculture service grows 5% per year
rationale: Analytical trajectory distinct from policy goals.

statement: Diesel/electric aquaculture efficiencies are 0.30/0.75
rationale: Engineering prior with no carrier share constraint.

statement: Aquaculture residual stock uses 60% historical utilization
rationale: Separates stock sizing from technical availability.

statement: Half of offshore longline catch enters modeled post-harvest
rationale: No complete Fiji processor throughput split is published.

statement: Residual-stock mix is 80% electricity/20% diesel with efficiencies 0.75/0.80
rationale: The mix sizes stock only and does not constrain dispatch.

statement: 2020 post-harvest service is carried flat through 2050
rationale: Avoids an unsupported processing target.

statement: Post-harvest residual stock uses 70% historical utilization
rationale: Residual equipment may idle.

statement: Four solar freezers use 0.2 kW each and COP 2.0
rationale: Official source reports count but not rating.

statement: Capture/post, aquaculture and solar lives are 15, 12 and 10 years
rationale: Uniform-age retirement avoids treating all stock as new in 2020.

statement: Capture/aquaculture availability is 0.90 and post-harvest 0.95
rationale: Technical availability is distinct from utilization.

statement: Technology-specific screening capex and fixed O&M schedule
rationale: Fiji supplier cost schedules were unavailable.

statement: The UN WPP 2024 medium population variant is the central Fiji population pathway for every year 2020-2050.
rationale: Uses a complete official annual pathway rather than extrapolating the 2020-2024 observations.

statement: Resident food availability per person is held at its 2021-2023 arithmetic mean through 2050.
rationale: Separates food requirement from drought-sensitive domestic production without inventing a dietary transition.
notes: Food availability is not a nutritional recommendation or observed consumption survey.

statement: Tourism is excluded as a separate crop or fish demand.
rationale: Explicit user scope; resident population is the only population driver.

statement: FAOSTAT Taro food tonnes represent the model CRPYAM taro/yam commodity.
rationale: CRPYAM is the existing aggregate root-crop commodity and no new crop commodity is introduced.

statement: CRPOTH retains the six 2020 crop items that exactly reproduce its inherited area and production boundary.
rationale: Keeps resident food and trade on the same existing commodity boundary.

statement: Milled rice is converted to paddy equivalent at 0.68 and the negligible husked-rice flow at 0.80.
rationale: The 0.68 value is observed in Fiji SUA for 2021-2023; 0.80 is a transparent immaterial screening proxy.

statement: Raw sugar demand and trade are converted to sugar-cane throughput equivalent at 0.14 tonne raw sugar per tonne cane.
rationale: Matches Fiji SUA raw centrifugal sugar output divided by cane processed in 2021-2023.

statement: Selected coconut product trade weights map one-for-one to the existing CRPCON commodity.
rationale: No processed-coconut commodity is added; the approximation is materiality-screened and disclosed.

statement: The 2025 crop-equivalent import floor and export demand remain constant per resident and scale with population through 2050.
rationale: This is an exogenous continuity rule, not a behavioral trade forecast.

statement: Each 2025 crop import quantity is a minimum; additional imports remain open so food demand can still be met after a domestic production crash.
rationale: Preserves the observed import presence without allowing it to erase the domestic sector by construction.

statement: Crop import backstops carry VC=10 as a domestic-first screening penalty rather than a border price.
rationale: Above the approximately 3.64 undiscounted maximum 2025 crop-balance marginal value in v2.7.

statement: All covered fish species and preservation states share one aggregate market-weight commodity.
rationale: Enables a transparent national balance without unsupported species/product conversion tables.

statement: One tonne of raw landed fish becomes one tonne of market-weight FSHFOOD; processing yield and edible fraction are not modeled.
rationale: Transparent screening convention for an aggregate mass balance.

statement: The 2025 retained fish import floor and domestic export commitment remain constant per resident and scale with population through 2050.
rationale: This is an exogenous continuity rule, not a price-responsive trade forecast.

statement: Resident-market fish imports equal the sum by HS heading of max(imports minus reported re-exports, zero).
rationale: Prevents processing and re-export throughput from displacing domestic supply in a non-trade model.

statement: The retained fish import quantity is a minimum and additional imports remain open when domestic fish production falls.
rationale: Represents continuity of current imports and food-security response without modeling bilateral trade.

statement: IMPFSHFOOD carries VC=200 as a domestic-first screening penalty rather than a border price.
rationale: Above the maximum domestic marginal value found in the retained-import VC=1000 pilot and below the rejected provisional penalty.

statement: The four one-year mass-link/backstop capacities carry CC=1e-6 solely to select minimum feasible accounting capacity.
rationale: Avoids arbitrary open-capacity values while having immaterial objective effect.

statement: The 2020 capture, aquaculture and post-harvest useful-service intensities remain constant per tonne through 2050.
rationale: No source-traceable full-horizon efficiency pathway is available.

statement: Aggregate capture activity is limited to the 2020 included offshore-longline plus coastal-commercial boundary through 2050.
rationale: Prevents unsupported capture expansion without claiming a legal quota or biological stock trajectory.

statement: Aggregate aquaculture activity uses observed 2021-2022 production through 2023 and detailed Aquaculture Development Plan Table 18 deliverables through 2028; the 2028 value is then held constant.
rationale: A conservative programme envelope proxies feed site facility and environmental expansion limits.
notes: Not a production target or resource-specific limit.

statement: Capture and aquaculture retain TAL=0 in every year; imports remain open.
rationale: Avoids forcing either subsector and preserves feasibility if domestic production is unavailable.

statement: Disposable diagnostics cap domestic crop or fish production at 5 percent of normal supply to test import response.
rationale: Diagnostic stress only; it is not a central scenario or a forecast of drought severity.
